title: Replace Elements with Greatest Element on Right Side
summary: Given an array, replace each element with the highest value to its right; the last element becomes -1.
statement: Given an array, replace each element with the highest value to its right; the last element becomes -1. Return the modified array.
constraints: Replace every value by the greatest value strictly to its right.
hints: Scan from right to left while storing the greatest value already seen.
Write the stored greatest before incorporating the current original value.
Initialize the stored value to -1 for the last position.
At each index the stored value is exactly the maximum of the strict suffix.
editorial: At each index the stored value is exactly the maximum of the strict suffix.

tests.explanation: No value lies to the right, so return -1.
